text: Group multiple data sources into a single collection searchable via one endpoint
quote: A collection is a group of different data sources that you can search using a single endpoint.

text: Source connections handle authentication and automatically sync data from an app or database
quote: A source connection links a specific app or database to your collection. It handles authentication and automatically syncs data.

text: Direct vector search returns results in about 0.5 seconds when speed matters most
quote: Direct vector search. Use when speed is critical (~0.5sec).

text: An AI agent can iteratively search data, read full documents, and navigate parent/child/sibling entity hierarchies to build comprehensive results
quote: An AI agent iteratively searches your data using tool calling. It searches with multiple strategies, reads full documents, navigates entity hierarchies (parent/child/sibling), and builds a comprehensive result set.

text: Official MCP server lets AI assistants search synced data via the Model Context Protocol
quote: The Airweave MCP server implements the Model Context Protocol to let AI assistants search your synced data.

text: Search any collection directly from the terminal via a CLI
quote: The primary use case — search any collection from your terminal

text: Published official skills let agents in Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and similar tools set up integrations and search data automatically
quote: Airweave publishes official skills so that agents in Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and other environments can set up integrations and search your data without you having to explain how every time.

text: Airweave Connect is a hosted embeddable widget for end users to connect apps like Slack, GitHub, Google Drive, and Notion inside a product
quote: Airweave Connect is a hosted, embeddable UI widget that lets end users connect their apps (Slack, GitHub, Google Drive, Notion, and more) directly inside your product.

text: Webhooks send real-time notifications for events like sync completion, connection creation, and collection updates
quote: Webhooks are real-time notifications that Airweave sends when things happen in your organization: syncs completing, source connections being created, collections being updated.

text: Authentication providers let users reuse existing authenticated connections from platforms like Composio or Pipedream
quote: Authentication providers let you reuse existing authenticated connections from third-party platforms such as Composio or Pipedream.

text: Self-hostable via a git clone and start script, deployable locally on macOS, Linux, or WSL
Agents can search across company knowledge bases, cloud drives, databases, and SaaS tools in a single query
quote: Airweave lets AI agents search across company knowledge bases, cloud drives, databases, and SaaS tools in a single query.

text: Agentic search mode favors recall over speed, taking up to 2 minutes when thoroughness matters more than latency
quote: Instant Search ... Direct vector search. Use when speed is critical (~0.5sec). ... Agentic Search ... Use when recall matters more than latency (<2min).

text: Filter search results by source, entity type, date, or other fields
quote: Use --filter to narrow results by source, entity type, date, or other fields

text: OAuth flows, credential forms, and connection management are handled automatically without needing a custom auth UI
quote: No auth UI to build OAuth flows, credential forms, and connection management are all handled for you.

text: Developers can build custom connectors to add support for new data sources
quote: Build a Custom Connector Follow our guide to add sup
